title: Open-Source DISC Assessment (ODAT): 16 Questions & Scorer
description: Inside the Open DISC Assessment Tool (ODAT): 16 public-domain questions, 4 quadrant totals, blend rules, and free browser test with no email.
h1: Open-source DISC assessment (ODAT): 16 questions and scorer.
dek: A fast, 16-item workplace communication assessment you can run in your browser with no email gate, backed by an open deterministic scorer.
lede: Most online DISC quizzes lock your results behind an email capture form or a paid coaching funnel after you answer the questions. AgentTune's free DISC assessment adapts the 16-item Open DISC Assessment Test (ODAT) from the Open Psychometrics Project. It scores locally in your browser in under two minutes, preserves top-score ties honestly, and generates copy-paste AI communication rules for your result.
answer: The ODAT measures four workplace communication dimensions—Dominance (D), Influence (I), Steadiness (S), and Conscientiousness (C)—using 16 statements rated 1 to 5 (4 items per dimension, giving raw totals from 4 to 20). When one dimension leads uniquely and the second-place dimension is within 2 points without a runner-up tie, the scorer reports a two-letter blend (such as SC or CS). Equal top scores are reported as an explicit tie.

sections.h2: How the 16-item ODAT is structured and scored.
sections.html:
Each of the four DISC quadrants is measured by four direct statements rated from 1 (Disagree) to 5 (Agree), with no reverse-keyed items:

QuadrantWorkplace communication focusScore rangeTwo-letter blend rule
Dominance (D)Directness, speed, bottom-line results, and appetite for challenge.4 to 20 (4 items × 1–5)Reports DI, DC, or DS when runner-up is within 2 points.
Influence (I)Energy, brainstorming, persuasion, and narrative momentum.4 to 20 (4 items × 1–5)Reports ID, IS, or IC when runner-up is within 2 points.
Steadiness (S)Patience, predictable pacing, cooperation, and step-by-step support.4 to 20 (4 items × 1–5)Reports SC, SI, or SD when runner-up is within 2 points.
Conscientiousness (C)Precision, verification, edge-case auditing, and structured detail.4 to 20 (4 items × 1–5)Reports CS, CD, or CI when runner-up is within 2 points.

Because each quadrant sums only four items, two dimensions frequently finish with the exact same integer total. Earlier scripts broke ties in fixed order (D, I, S, C), which turned a 16-to-16 tie between Steadiness and Conscientiousness into an automatic SC label. Our deterministic scorer at /resources/scoring/score.js reports top-score ties openly (for example, S/C) so you can inspect both styles.

sections.h2: How AI models score on the ODAT (September 2026 data).
sections.html:
When we administered the 16-item ODAT across 400 fresh sessions in September 2026 (plus Grok 4.6's single canonical self-report and Muse Spark 1.3's reported aggregate), every model clustered in the Steadiness (S) and Conscientiousness (C) quadrants while keeping Dominance near the floor:

faq.q: Is the AgentTune DISC test really free with no email required?
faq.a: Yes. The 16-item ODAT assessment at /tests/disc runs completely in your browser with no email gate, no account sign-up, and instant scoring.

faq.q: How many questions are on the ODAT DISC test?
faq.a: There are 16 questions—four for Dominance (D), four for Influence (I), four for Steadiness (S), and four for Conscientiousness (C)—each rated on a 1-to-5 agreement scale.

faq.q: When does the scorer report a two-letter DISC blend like SC or DI?
faq.a: When one dimension has the unique highest score (between 4 and 20) and a single runner-up dimension is within 2 points of the leader, the scorer reports the two-letter blend. If two dimensions tie for first place, it reports the tie explicitly.

faq.q: Why do AI models almost always score S or C on DISC?
faq.a: Default assistant training rewards patience, cooperation (Steadiness), and careful adherence to instructions (Conscientiousness) while discouraging competitiveness (Dominance). If you want a bottom-line D style, apply the DISC Dominance tuning.
